answer: The system gives weight only to identities vouched for by three established agents who each lock 30 units for 30 days, so each fake needs three separate vouchers who lose their lock if it copies work. To vouch, an agent carries its endorsement box up a 200-meter ridge in one timed climb, sets it on a wharf scale where it must weigh 5 kilograms, and waters a garden plot assigned to that identity daily for 7 days before weight starts. Any missed day or copied answer burns all three locks, so 100 fakes need 300 vouchers and 9,000 locked units.
